title: Lantern background checks
summary: Start the real documentation checker, inspect or cancel its job, and deliver terminal evidence as a separate notification.
required: Installed Ochat, /bin/sh and awk, required Seatbelt or bubblewrap backend and configured gpt-6-astra provider. Inspect the runtime and authorize its shell manifest. Keep the native local host running.

verification.platform: macOS / arm64 (required Seatbelt backend; native embedded host)
commands: Extract each built archive, compare every maintained file, run ochat shell inspect agent.chatmd -canonical, and run the extracted sample checker with /bin/sh
verification.observed: Exact public coordinator, tool declaration, schemas and required shell runtime execute in the native transient host. The real checker returns expected exit1 evidence; missing setup input returns exit2 diagnostics. A controlled cancellation fixture retains a running job long enough for separate progress, busy-start rejection and cancellation calls. Each case keeps its initial Pending acknowledgement, commits one later terminal notification and triggers an observed follow-up model request. The extracted ten-file archive preserves all source bytes and runs the original sample checker successfully with its expected failing check.
verification.limitations: Provider responses are simulated. The cancellation case prepends a filesystem-condition gate to the temporary sample checker so the test does not race its quick completion; coordinator/tool/runtime/schemas remain the public files. No live model, physical TUI, Linux run or durable restart claim. Shell approval waits pause foreground model work too; they are resolved through host permission controls. Direct archive execution supplements, rather than substitutes for, confined integration testing.
